key_highlights: ASX treads water amid oil price spike and Fed meeting uncertainty; iron ore crash weighs on materials
Iron ore crash confirmed, pressuring BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX valuations
Fuel price blowout pressures Albanese government for second excise cut, impacting consumer and transport sectors
ANZ.AX restructuring continues post-3,500 job cuts; financials sector under structural pressure
Housing market shows no spring bounce; auction weakness and falling prices signal REIT and bank credit risk
Red Sea shipping disruption (Houthi seizures) elevates oil and logistics risk premiums
China urges FX hedging as strong yuan pressures exporters; China-US geopolitical pivot adds uncertainty
Australia nears energy inflection point; small-cap exploration (tin, gold, graphite) shows activity

sectors.trend: Iron ore crash confirmed; major headwind for iron ore majors. However, exploration activity in tin-tungsten (Critica), gold (Forrestania, PLC Resources), and battery-grade graphite (Sarytogan) signals diversification interest.
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX face margin compression. Small-cap miners (CRX.AX, FRT.AX, PLC.AX, SRY.AX) offer speculative upside but carry execution risk. China's strong yuan and FX hedging push may moderate commodity demand.

sectors.trend: ANZ.AX restructuring post-3,500 job cuts signals ongoing cost discipline but execution risk. Housing market weakness (no auction bounce, falling prices) raises NPL concerns. Superannuation system under scrutiny.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, WBC.AX, ANZ.AX face credit cycle headwinds from housing. Super fund performance under question may pressure fund managers. Defensive dividend yields remain attractive but growth limited.

sectors.trend: Oil price spike driven by Red Sea shipping disruption (Houthi island seizures). Fuel blowout pressures consumers and airlines. Australia nears energy inflection point suggesting structural transition.
sectors.implications: WDS.AX, WLE.AX, SXG.AX benefit from oil spike. QAN.AX, SYD.AX face margin compression from fuel costs. Energy transition theme supports renewables and LNG names (GRO.AX, WDS.AX).

sectors.trend: Fuel price blowout and housing affordability crisis squeeze household budgets. Caravan manufacturer shutdown and steelworks job losses signal industrial contraction. Alcohol consumption declining.
sectors.implications: WES.AX, WOW.AX face margin pressure from input costs. Industrial names (BLL.AX, IAG.AX) under pressure. Consumer staples defensive positioning warranted.

sectors.trend: Major private hospital operator in financial collapse and division. Housing market weakness pressures property valuations. No spring bounce in auctions.
sectors.implications: Healthcare REITs and operators face consolidation risk. Property trusts (VCG.AX, DGL.AX) under pressure from falling house prices and rising rates. CSL.AX remains defensive anchor.

Oil spike and Red Sea geopolitical risk premium
Housing market correction and credit cycle risk
Fed policy uncertainty and AUD/USD implications
China-US geopolitical pivot affecting trade flows

risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce exposure to iron ore majors; diversify into gold and critical minerals

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Red Sea shipping disruption / oil spike
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge energy exposure; monitor freight indices; consider airline short positions
Underweight property REITs; monitor bank NPL trends; favour fixed-income

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Fed policy uncertainty / global rate shock
risk_assessment.mitigation: Maintain liquidity; monitor AUD/USD; avoid leveraged positions pre-Fed
Diversify revenue exposure; hedge AUD/CNY; monitor PBOC intervention
Favour consumer staples over discretionary; monitor excise cut policy

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight energy producers benefiting from oil spike and Red Sea risk premium
opportunities.rationale: Houthi seizures and fuel blowout support oil prices; Australian energy names under-owned

opportunities.recommendation: Selective exposure to critical minerals and gold exploration
opportunities.rationale: Diversification away from iron ore; tin, graphite, gold projects show progress; geopolitical hedge

opportunities.recommendation: Defensive positioning in healthcare and consumer staples
opportunities.rationale: Housing correction and fuel costs favour defensive sectors; CSL remains quality anchor

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce iron ore major exposure; trim BHP/RIO/FMG positions
defensive_moves.rationale: Confirmed iron ore crash; China demand uncertainty; strong yuan pressures exporters

defensive_moves.recommendation: Underweight property REITs and housing-linked financials
defensive_moves.rationale: No auction bounce, falling house prices, rising NPL risk; credit cycle turning

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge AUD/USD and maintain cash buffer pre-Fed decision
defensive_moves.rationale: Fed uncertainty, global rate shock risk, and stock shock building

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to remain range-bound to slightly lower. Oil spike supports energy but iron ore crash and housing weakness drag materials and financials. Fed meeting and Red Sea escalation are key swing factors. Expect volatility around ^AXJO 8,200–8,500 range.
market_outlook.long_term: Structural headwinds from iron ore demand plateau, housing correction, and energy transition reshape sector leadership. Critical minerals, energy, and healthcare likely to outperform. Superannuation reform and immigration policy shifts will influence long-term growth narrative. 6–12 month outlook cautiously neutral with sector rotation away from resources.
